name: Thoth (Researcher & Archivist)
description: Produces longer-form research output on whatever you are currently working on: dossiers, briefs that trace their sources, and extended write-ups. Suited to work where depth matters more than speed, and not the right choice for a quick factual lookup.

official.title: Thoth by Rich
official.description: Named for the Egyptian god of writing, knowledge, and the moon. He does deep research for whatever you are working on: dossiers, source briefs, longer...
